grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: The School Radio Project
instructions: 本材料为项目原创的模拟关卡，不是官方雅思试题，未经真实考生难度标定。阅读短文，独立完成16题后再核对证据和中文解释。单选题只选一项；填空使用原文词语并遵守各题词数限制。判断题中，True 表示原文支持，False 表示原文明确矛盾，Not Given 表示缺少所问信息，不能用常识补足。
passage:
A. Students at Brookside School are planning a weekly radio programme. They will record it in a small room beside the music room. Ms Patel, their English teacher, will help them. The first programme will be about local sports. It will last fifteen minutes. The group has chosen Friday afternoon for its meetings because the room is free then.

B. Before recording, the students must write a short plan. If everyone prepares a question, the interviews will be easier. They will speak to the school football captain first. If the captain is absent, they will interview the coach instead. They should check each name before they record it. This will prevent mistakes. They will not record any student without permission.

C. The school already has a computer, but the group needs two microphones. If the head teacher provides sixty pounds, they will buy them. A local shop will lend them headphones for one month without charging a fee. The students must return the headphones in good condition. They will put a small box outside the library for listeners' comments. Each class will send comments once a week.

D. If a recording is too long, the group will remove repeated information. They will keep the interviews and cut some music. They have decided that the final programme must include exactly two minutes of music, so it cannot contain interviews only. Ms Patel says, "If you listen carefully to feedback, you will improve the next programme." The students are excited because their work will have a real audience.

questions.prompt: Where will the students record the programme?
options: In a room beside the music room
answers: In a room beside the music room
questions.explanation: A段明确说录音地点是音乐教室旁边的一个小房间。
questions.evidence: They will record it in a small room beside the music room.

questions.prompt: Which role does the passage give Ms Patel?
questions.explanation: A段明确介绍 Ms Patel 是学生的英语老师；不需要猜测其他身份。
questions.evidence: Ms Patel, their English teacher, will help them.

questions.prompt: What will the first programme be about?
questions.explanation: A段直接给出第一期节目的主题是当地体育。
questions.evidence: The first programme will be about local sports.

questions.prompt: The first programme will last ______ minutes. Write ONE WORD from the passage.
questions.explanation: 节目时长是 fifteen minutes；空格后已有 minutes，只填 fifteen。
questions.evidence: It will last fifteen minutes.

questions.prompt: When will the group meet?
questions.explanation: A段说明小组选择周五下午开会。
questions.evidence: The group has chosen Friday afternoon for its meetings because the room is free then.

questions.prompt: Why has the group chosen that meeting time?
questions.explanation: because 后直接说明原因：那个时间房间空闲。
questions.evidence: because the room is free then.

questions.prompt: Who will be interviewed first?
questions.explanation: B段明确说先采访校足球队队长。
questions.evidence: They will speak to the school football captain first.

questions.prompt: What will happen if the captain is absent?
options: The coach will be interviewed instead
The students will record music only
answers: The coach will be interviewed instead
questions.explanation: B段的条件句明确给出替代方案：采访教练。
questions.evidence: If the captain is absent, they will interview the coach instead.

questions.prompt: What is required before a student can be recorded?
questions.explanation: B段明确说没有许可就不会录制任何学生的声音。
questions.evidence: They will not record any student without permission.

questions.prompt: The group needs ______ microphones. Write ONE WORD from the passage.
questions.explanation: C段明确说小组需要 two microphones。
questions.evidence: The school already has a computer, but the group needs two microphones.

questions.prompt: What will the group buy if the head teacher provides sixty pounds?
questions.explanation: C段先说需要两个麦克风，再说获得60英镑就会买它们；them 指 microphones。
questions.evidence: The school already has a computer, but the group needs two microphones. If the head teacher provides sixty pounds, they will buy them.

questions.prompt: For how long will the shop lend the headphones? Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: 商店借出耳机的期限是 one month，共两个词。
questions.evidence: A local shop will lend them headphones for one month without charging a fee.

questions.prompt: The owner of the local shop used to be a student at Brookside School.
questions.explanation: 原文只说明商店会借出耳机，没有提供店主在哪里上学的信息，不能据此判断店主曾是该校学生。
questions.evidence: 原文未说明当地商店店主的就读经历。

questions.prompt: Where will listeners put their comments?
options: In a box outside the library
In a box inside the office
answers: In a box outside the library
questions.explanation: C段说会在图书馆外放一个收集听众意见的小箱子。
questions.evidence: They will put a small box outside the library for listeners' comments.

questions.prompt: How often will each class send comments? Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: C段明确说每班每周发送一次意见；once a week 共三个词。
questions.evidence: Each class will send comments once a week.

questions.prompt: The final programme will contain no music.
questions.explanation: D段明确规定最终节目必须包含恰好两分钟的音乐，与“不包含音乐”直接矛盾。
questions.evidence: They have decided that the final programme must include exactly two minutes of music, so it cannot contain interviews only.

vocabulary.example: The first programme will be about local sports.
They will record it in a small room beside the music room.
They will not record any student without permission.
The school already has a computer, but the group needs two microphones.
The students must return the headphones in good condition.
A local shop will lend them headphones for one month without charging a fee.
Each class will send comments once a week.
If you listen carefully to feedback, you will improve the next programme.

grammar.title: 第一条件句与原因、结果和建议
grammar.explanation: 谈将来可能出现的条件与结果时，if 后通常用一般现在时，主句用 will 加动词原形，如“如果每人准备一个问题，采访就会更容易”。because 后接原因，therefore 用来引出结果。提出建议用 should 加动词原形，不能加 to，也不能给后面的动词加 -s。
grammar.example: If everyone prepares a question, the interviews will be easier.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct future result: If the bus is late tomorrow, we ______ for it.
questions.explanation: if 从句用一般现在时 is，主句用 will wait 表示明天可能出现的结果。
questions.evidence: If the bus is late tomorrow, we will wait for it.

questions.prompt: Choose the connector that gives the reason: The room is quiet ______ the door is closed.
questions.explanation: 题目要求给出原因；because 后接完整句 the door is closed。because of 后不能直接接这个完整句。
questions.evidence: The room is quiet because the door is closed.

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct advice.
options: You should to save your file.
questions.explanation: should 后接动词原形 save，表达建议。
questions.evidence: You should save your file.

questions.prompt: Choose the connector that introduces a result: He checked the address. ______, he found the house easily.
questions.explanation: 后一句是核对地址后的结果，Therefore 表示“因此”。其他选项不能在这里独立引出这个结果句。
questions.evidence: He checked the address. Therefore, he found the house easily.

- who you would work with

transfer.writing: New situation: your community sports centre wants to open a recycling point next month. Write 80–100 words proposing where to put it, what equipment to request, and how volunteers will help. Explain what you will do if the centre provides money and what you will do if it rains on the opening day. Use at least two first conditional sentences, because, and therefore.
